title: Guard binary consolidation
description: Guard feature sprawls across 3 locations: src/guard.rs (325 lines), src/bin/guard.rs (5,174 lines — largest file by 4x), and main.rs guard install/uninstall (130 lines).\n\nThin the binary by reusing library code. Move install/uninstall logic from main.rs to guard module. Investigate whether the 5k-line binary contains significant duplicated utility code.

acceptance_criteria.text: Guard-related code consolidated into fewer locations
Install/uninstall logic moved out of main.rs
Binary reuses library code instead of duplicating

decisions: Left bin/guard.rs (166 lines) as-is — its raw rusqlite is intentional for hook-path performance, avoiding Db::open() migration overhead
